scope: global across colors and cold/warm restarts

flash.program_order: erase older sector, program uncommitted record, read verify, program 4-byte commit, read verify

behavior: Pause/clear both DMA halves for flash write, keep old setting on failure, reset output queue and settle/fade, restore preceding playback intent if healthy. Invalid, IRQ-context, booting or pending-recall requests are ignored. Same setting with no pending storage error does not write.
presets: Recall ignores legacy per-color buffer. Occupied metadata replies report the current global setting in the existing buffer field. Save requests must use that effective value; setting global buffer does not rewrite preset records.
installation: Clears bank and settings; fresh install defaults to 8. Physical restart/write endurance unverified.
